A '''poster''' was put up on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to advertise a series of [[Cabaret/Legends|cabarets]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It showed a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]<ref name="Duchess of Mandalore" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/lethal-trackdown-trivia-gallery|text="Lethal Trackdown" Trivia Gallery|quote=The nightclub on Coruscant is filled with posters of various female pin-up models}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref> posing in a revealing outfit. The same motif was featured on the facade of the business, but while the [[Painting/Legends|poster]] put up in the [[Galactic City/Legends|city]] streets also featured the same [[Color/Legends|color]] palette as the one on the facade,<ref name="Duchess of Mandalore" /> a differently colored version was put up in [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the planet's seedy [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]].<ref name="Lethal">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref>
